privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draftNotice: This is the first version (v1) of this policy, written by our team based on what the site actually does. It hasn't gone through formal legal review yet — we'll update it as the project grows.
privacy.intro: My Heart Before God is a quiz and book catalog for parents. We take seriously that we're handling information about children, even without identifying them directly. This page explains what we do with the data you give us.
collect: Your child's age range (not their exact birth date)
Optional open-ended text, only if you agree to share it
privacy.consentResearch: At the end of the quiz, we ask if we can use your open-ended answers (without identifying you or your child) to improve future books in the collection. If you don't check that box, none of that text is saved — not even a record saying you declined.
privacy.consentMarketing: If you leave your email to receive your result, you can separately choose whether you want to hear about new books. Declining that never keeps you from receiving your result by email.
privacy.providersTitle: Who processes this data for us
privacy.providersIntro: We use a small number of external services, each chosen for what it does, not by default:
privacy.providerSupabase: Supabase (database, servers in the European Union) stores your answers and, if you leave it, your email.
privacy.providerResend: Resend sends the result email, when you ask for it.
privacy.providerPostHog: PostHog (servers in the European Union) records how pages are used (not the content of your answers) so we can understand what's working. Today it starts running as soon as you open the site, without asking permission first — we know this is a real gap and plan to add a cookie notice to fix it.
privacy.securityTitle: How we protect what you share
security: Every input is validated on the server before being saved
Open-ended text has a size limit
We limit how many times the same visitor can submit forms in a short time
A hidden field helps block automated (bot) submissions
The whole site runs on HTTPS
Technical keys and secrets never reach your browser
privacy.contactBody: We don't yet have a dedicated support channel with our own domain for this project — that's something we plan to add once the site is past its early stage.
